summary: Diana Shipping Inc. filed a Form 6-K disclosing results of its 2026 annual meeting of shareholders held on May 28, 2026. Shareholders approved election of three Class III directors and ratification of Deloitte as independent auditor for fiscal year ending December 31, 2026. No transaction, strategic review, activist campaign, or other special situation is disclosed. This is a routine routine meeting results filing for a foreign private issuer, equivalent to a Form 8-K Item 5.07 for a US domestic issuer. There are no deal terms, price, premium, or risk-arb angle to watch.
